description: This file contains internal implementation classes for fault injection testing in Orleans transactions. It defines classes that manage transaction lifecycle and resources with deliberate fault injection points for testing robustness and fault handling.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionManager`1
classes.description: A transaction manager that supports fault injection for testing transaction phases, including prepare, commit, prepare acknowledgment, and ping, with optional deactivation after certain phases.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalResource`1
classes.description: A transactional resource wrapper supporting fault injection points during read-only commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare phases.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction, with potential fault injection before the operation and deactivation after.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Marks a transaction as prepared, with optional deactivation after the phase.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to keep the transaction alive, with optional fault injection and deactivation.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Commits a read-only transaction with fault injection points.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts a transaction with fault injection support.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a transaction with fault injection support.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction, supporting fault injection before and after storage during confirm phase.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a transaction, with fault injection points before and after prepare.
